title: Performer run bundle manifest
description: Describes a single measurement run. Written by the collector, read by the viewer. This file is the contract between the two halves of the project.

schema_version.description: Bundle format version. Bumped on any breaking change; viewers must refuse unknown majors.

run_id.description: Unique run identifier: <UTC compact timestamp>-<label>. Also the name of the run directory inside the archive.

label.description: Human-chosen short name. Ends up in file names, so the character set is restricted.

tags.description: Free-form tags used by the viewer for grouping and filtering runs.

notes.description: Free text shown in the viewer. Not interpreted.

started_at.description: UTC start of the measurement window (RFC 3339, Z suffix mandatory).

ended_at.description: UTC end of the measurement window. Absent if the collector was killed before it could finish writing.

actual_duration_s.description: Wall clock time actually spent collecting. Differs from duration_s when the target died or --until-exit was used.

profile.description: Name of the collection profile (collector/profiles/<name>.yaml). Whitelisted; never a path.

status.description: Run level outcome. 'partial' means the bundle is readable but incomplete (probe failure, target died, signal not delivered).

target_died_at.description: Set when the /proc watcher observed the target process disappear mid-run. Implies status != ok.

probes.description: One entry per probe the profile asked for, including the ones that failed. Probes are never dropped silently.

files.description: Inventory of the payload files in the bundle. Lets the viewer know which optional artifacts exist without probing, and lets inspect verify integrity.

warnings.description: Run level warnings that do not belong to a single probe.

cmdline.description: argv of the target, split on NUL as read from /proc/<pid>/cmdline.

exe.description: Resolved /proc/<pid>/exe. Needed to attach uprobes and to resolve symbols later.

status.description: ok = ran and produced output; partial = ran but lost events or was killed hard; failed = smoke test or startup failed; skipped = not requested or disabled by preflight.

events_lost.description: Events dropped by the kernel or by a full bpftrace map. Non-zero means the numbers are a lower bound.

exit_reason.description: How the probe process ended. 'sigkill' means bpftrace never got to dump its maps for that probe.

thresholds.description: Effective thresholds the probe ran with, e.g. {"min_us": 100}. Recorded because they change what the data means.

outputs.description: Bundle relative paths produced by this probe.

quality.description: Trust metadata. The viewer red flags a run from this block alone, so it is mandatory.

frame_pointers_ok.description: False when the preflight stack sample was dominated by [unknown] frames, i.e. the target was built without -fno-omit-frame-pointer.

unknown_frame_ratio.description: Fraction of sampled frames that could not be symbolised. Above 0.30 the flame graphs are misleading.

estimated_overhead_pct.description: Rough target CPU overhead attributed to the measurement, from utime+stime sampled before and after the run.

ignore_quality.description: True when the operator forced collection past a failed frame pointer check with --ignore-quality.

rows.description: Line/record count where meaningful (folded stacks, CSV series).

relpath.description: Bundle relative path. Forward slashes, no leading slash, no '..' component.
